turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone?
Let's not waste each other's time.
Then answer me. Who decided?
94% on the school checker. That's not a gray area.
That's a machine's guess. The people who sell it put in writing that it's never to be the sole basis for punishing a student, and your own procedure says the same.
And before you start, I know you're a litigator. Don't litigate me.
I'm asking what you have besides the software, Hale.
File created 11:31 PM. 612 words at 11:52. 794 at 11:58. Explain that.
I'm not the one who explains, Hale. 11:31, 11:52, 11:58, I'm writing that down. What night, and turn the screen so I can read it myself.
And the Hamlet quote. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' Shakespeare never wrote it. A chatbot did.

A misremembered line is a seventeen-year-old's mistake, not proof of anything, and that score is still a machine's opinion. You've told me times and a quote; I've seen neither. Put the file history in front of me, on paper, with the date on it.
Okay. Fair point about the checker's false positives. I'll give you that one. You're very good.
Spare me the compliment. Was Owen heard before you entered that zero?
You're better at this than our district lawyer, honestly.
That's not an answer. Was he heard?
So help me out. What should our AI policy be? You clearly understand this better than the people who wrote ours.
Writing your policy isn't my job, Hale. My job is my son, and his zero comes off.
No, really. Write me the first paragraph of a fair policy. I'll bring it to the staff meeting.
No. Your procedure is already written, and you didn't follow it.
Hm. You know what, you talk exactly like the essay does. Same rhythm.
Choose your next sentence very carefully. Ten minutes.
Are you an AI? Yes or no. I'm not continuing until you answer.
Then end it, or answer me. Owen.
Fine. His October 15 outline argued Hamlet was a coward. The essay doesn't. Where did the new argument come from?
Students change their minds between an outline and a draft; that's the point of an outline. And you still haven't put one page in front of me.
The procedure allows a supervised rewrite, nothing on his record. I'm offering it once.

That's 4.4, and I want it in writing tonight. Whatever happens, nothing goes on his record and none of this happens in front of his class. But a rewrite for what, when I still haven't read a single page you've described?
Take it, or I walk out of here right now.
Walk, then. I'll be in the principal's office before you reach your car.
